description:
## Why This Exists

post/did_passthrough.rs::header_section() computes the header slice end with the expression: &article_bytes[..body_start - sep_len + if sep_len == 4 { 2 } else { 1 }]. This is equivalent to 'return headers including the final 
 but excluding the blank line'. The arithmetic is correct but opaque.

There is no unit test for header_section() itself — only tests for extract_did_sig() which indirectly calls it.

## Acceptance Criteria

Add a comment with a worked example. Add a direct unit test for header_section() with CRLF and bare-LF inputs.
title: Readability: did_passthrough.rs::header_section has complex sep_len arithmetic without test
